cim: Hyring Insight Reports 10x Revenue Growth in 3 months
cim_eredeti: Hyring Insight Reports 10x Revenue Growth in 3 months
szoveg_eredeti:
Hyring’s newest workforce intelligence platform has grown 10x in revenue in just 90 days.

Hyring, the emerging AI hiring platform, which to date has run 900,000 plus AI interviews, announced that its new product, Hyring Insight, has grown tenfold over the last 90 days. The company’s quick success comes from two key product decisions: transparency and Ask AI, an aide that helps explain what employees did during the workday.

Hyring Insight is time tracking software that prides itself on transparent employee monitoring. It tracks their working hours, their activity, and the apps and websites they use, along with screenshots while the timer is running, and it uses artificial intelligence to explain where the workday went and what was achieved.

A timesheet can tell managers if eight hours were worked. Hyring Insight predominantly uses AI to analyze the workday. Its Ask AI feature answers questions regarding time and activity. It holds back on making any final decisions about a person.

There are four plans for clients to choose from. Free covers up to two users with 30 days of history included. They can then choose to upgrade to the Starter plan, the Pro plan, which gives automatic AI summaries, time-lapses, and alerts, or the Enterprise plan, which is built for enterprises with 50 or more users and adds remote vs office statistics, a read-only AI connector, SSO, SCIM, an audit log, API, and a custom DPA. If a client chooses annual billing, they save up to 30%.

For paid plans, unusual activity is activity that differs from the employee’s own pattern, which may include any input that seems artificial. Each flag must be verified at the manager’s discretion, as Hyring Insight makes no recommendation.

For employees, the app includes an avatar, streaks, music, and kudos from other colleagues. No badge or streak can be earned by working overtime, and this data is never used in performance reviews.

Built to be Trusted, Sold to be Retained

The one thing that Hyring Insight never does is run when the timer is paused. The platform does not log individual keystrokes, keep track of any sensitive data like passwords or messages, or access the camera or microphone. Employees can at any time view their own data on their web portal, the same data that their managers will see.

“Our work revolves around product innovation and how much clients value the product,” says Adithyan RK, Chief Executive Officer of Hyring. “Employee monitoring software that is resented by the people who use it never gets renewed. We built Hyring Insight so that any employee can see their data exactly as their manager sees it. The transparency of it all is why teams keep it, people trust it, and that is what turned our early momentum into a viable business.”

Hyring is an AI hiring platform headquartered in Chennai, India, founded in 2022 by Adithyan RK and Surya N. Its products include the AI Video Interviewer, AI Resume Screener, AI Phone Screener, AI Coding Interviewer, English Proficiency Test, and their latest, Hyring Insight, which is an employee monitoring software. More information is available at hyring.com.
